title: soroseris gillii subsp. hirsuta
intro: Soroseris gillii subsp. hirsuta, commonly known as the hairy soroseris, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Himalayas, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Soroseris gillii subsp. hirsuta include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its use as an antidote for poison. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
